claim.statement: The claim-integrity buildout refuses decisive contribution claims without sufficient observable evidence while preserving reachable positive and negative verdict poles for its core decision gates.
claim.scope: PCF code at 00f1d7552a868b3a677fed26078c56aa8de1ce73; focused claim-integrity, residue-register, repro, lane, diff-shape, and policy-scan controls exercised by CI.

generalization.statement: PCF evidence gates should neither manufacture decisive verdicts from absent evidence nor erase legitimate verdicts when sufficient evidence is present.
testedShapes: caller-claimed metadata conflicts with observed evidence
negative verdict pole collapses to PASS
narrow claim inflated into an untested general invariant

surface.observable: GitHub Actions executes the code-complete commit and the unit/reachability/red-test controls emit deterministic gate states.

positive.description: A fully supported two-sided high-risk claim with authoritative execution evidence, fresh routing, and complete root-cause chain reaches PASS.

negative.description: A decisive claim whose evidence surface is absent reaches FAIL/BLOCKED rather than being laundered by otherwise plausible controls.

rootCause.symptom: PCF could require artifacts and before/after commands yet still lacked a first-class contract proving that the evidence surface actually supported the claim or that both verdict poles remained reachable.
rootCause.reachability: A contribution could clear the repro/evidence-presence layer with structured command results while the claimed property itself was under-observed, overgeneralized, stale-routed, or evaluated by a one-sided mechanism.
rootCause.invariant: A decisive contribution claim must be tied to a judgeable observable surface, higher-authority observations must outrank claims, and each contract that permits two outcomes must keep both verdict poles reachable.
rootCause.patchMechanism: Add Claim -> Evidence Surface -> Controls -> Verdict Reachability, evidence-authority ordering, high-risk root-cause chain, routing freshness, falsification packets, shrink-only residue registers, and a zero-residue core-gate reachability ratchet.
